# SharePoint.Tables

```m
SharePoint.Tables(url as text, optional options as nullable record) as table
```

Returns a table containing content from a SharePoint List.

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/sharepoint-tables)
